Where your company stands, at every step

A clear view of the journey, from name reservation to follow-up filings. Timings are estimates and depend on documents and official approvals.

Hurray — your company is incorporated!

INC-22 filed

Commencement of business is declared — your company is ready to trade.

Private Limited or LLP?

A quick side-by-side, so you can decide with Finbot before you file.

Private Limited Company

  • Limited liability — your personal assets stay protected.
  • Fundraising-ready — the natural structure for equity investors.
  • Separate legal identity — the company outlives its founders.
  • Stronger credibility — with banks, clients, and vendors.
  • ESOP-friendly — for hiring and retaining a team.

LLP

  • Limited liability — same core protection as a company.
  • Lighter compliance — fewer filings, lower running cost.
  • No mandatory audit — below the prescribed turnover.
  • Flexible management — partners run it their way.
  • Simple to maintain — well suited to services and consulting.
